scope: One review task per positive event in the latest frozen HL2 training dataset; negative events inventoried from metadata only.
owner_authorization: 2026-09-08: 还有我们最新的模型数据那8000多张的图打得标是怎么样的 实际是1000多张是吗 也放到label studio 我来手动调整 这周我们要彻底整理好数据集。Resolved latest trained version: HL2. Separate future40 and prefilled editable boxes continue the prior explicit review instructions.
representative_rule: Largest window, then most post bars, lowest variant index and dataset_sample_id; reused grade_a_manual_pack.representative.
context_rule: Earliest window start, then largest window and dataset_sample_id; copied from the current HL2 dataset.
main_image: Byte-exact current HL2 training PNG, without burned-in rectangles.
labels: Actual current positive YOLO txt only; class 0=dense_long, 1=dense_short; converted directly into Label Studio percentage rectangles, never centrally reboxed.
transform_lineage: Frozen close manual lineage matched by sample ID, baseline image/label hashes, split and window fields; HL2 preserves this canvas transform. Each selected main image must replay pixel-exactly using HL2 MAs and that transform.
source_reads: All manifest metadata passes before positive image/label reads. Future OHLCV is read only after all main images and actual label lineage are frozen, with bounded read_preholdout_prefix. Full raw CSV hashes are never computed.
synthetic_controls: HL2 main replay and prefix initialization
future mutation does not alter main PNG or label
